name: Simplex-based Encoding
definition: A method for encoding graphics primitives (images, SDFs, NeRFs) using simplex-based structures instead of grid-based structures to reduce computational overhead from exponential scaling (2^n vertices) to linear scaling (n+1 vertices) with dimensionality.
summary: Simplex-based encoding represents graphics primitives using simplex structures to reduce computational overhead, distinguishing itself by using simplex topology for efficient feature storage and interpolation in high-dimensional spaces.
